BiblicalUsage: Husham is a king of Edom, from the land of Teman, who reigns after Jobab and before Hadad. His name appears twice, once in the list of Edomite kings and once in the chronicle that copies it. He rules a kingdom outside Israel, and the record keeps his reign.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Husham matters because God records the kings of Edom too, and no kingdom stands outside His knowledge.
